title: Download designed quotation conversion reports as PDF
description: A user downloads the currently designed scoped quotation conversion report as PDF with the same selected columns, date context and original-currency buckets as preview/Excel. Add a PDF endpoint to the prerequisite controller that independently validates and reauthorizes and obtains server-derived bounded preview data. Add one narrow Infrastructure exporter using existing PDFsharp and SimHeiPdfFontResolver without package or font-secret changes. Paginate rows and wide columns, render empty evidence, label original currencies and never produce a mixed-currency money grand total. Missing font/render failure must return a clear error with no corrupt or misleading file. The existing designer retains current field order/date context in the PDF request and surfaces download failures; no new persistence or DB model is needed. Development only: reuse existing ERP services, current-user menu permissions and SalespersonDataScopeService; OperationLogMiddleware audits API calls. No new authorization privileges, direct table writes, arbitrary SQL, schema/migration/stored-procedure/view changes, production SQL, real database execution, irreversible actions, secrets/.env changes, deployment or real browser acceptance. Verify focused in-memory or source-contract tests and the configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external environments must be marked blocked, never reported passed. Preserve unrelated work.
acceptance_criteria: PDF requests independently validate selected fields/dates and recheck current quotation-menu/customer scope, use the same bounded server preview and refuse revoked, invalid or source-limit requests without a file.

A narrow PDF exporter renders selected-column order, dates, salesperson/currency buckets, row/column pagination and empty evidence without cross-currency totals; missing fonts or rendering failures fail explicitly.

The designer preserves current fields/dates on PDF download and reports errors; focused PDF/UI tests cover scope revocation, invalid input, mixed currencies, empty and multi-page output, font failure and safe Release build/test passes.
